ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) to 35% high-intensity (white/off-white) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are localized to the lateral lobes. Left lobe exhibits a white contiguous region with discrete circular black mottling. Right lobe features a white contiguous region with dense, fine-grained black stippling and diagonal linear disruptions. The central region from the peduncle connection to the notch is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Notable macro-indentation on the distal end of the left lobe. Right lobe edge shows a more uniform, fine-toothed pixel-amplitude variation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetrical convexity along the leading edges, transitioning to a slight posterior concavity toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-intensity spots (approximately 3-5 distinct clusters) on the white portion of the left lobe. A single larger circular mark is visible near the top-center of the left white region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-6 parallel diagonal rake marks (low-intensity lines) cutting through the white pigmentation of the right lobe. A singular, longer diagonal mark is visible on the left lobe's white surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on both lobes; distinct brownish-orange pixel clusters (diatom or skin transition) along the inner borders where white and black pigmentation meet.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant jagged fragmentation on the outer terminal edge of the left lobe compared to the more intact right terminal edge.
